verdict.rationale: Isaac exposes substantial programmatic control. Standalone Python scripts control robots and environments, pip-installable Python packages let you compose the app, and headless operation and workflow automation are documented. ROS 2 services can load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations, and Isaac Lab ships agent skills for setup and training. Nothing documents that every UI action (scene assembly, materials, robot tuning, import tools) has an API equivalent, and the probes found no published API spec. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API reference coverage of GUI-only workflows such as scene assembly and robot tuning, and independent hands-on confirmation of full parity.
